hints.title: Bounded Intermediate States
hints.text: Intermediate states can only be expanded if they fall within the range zero to one thousand inclusive.

hints.title: Three State Operations
hints.text: Explore all three operations: addition, subtraction, and bitwise difference.

hints.title: Target Match Verification
hints.text: If an operation produces the goal target, return the operation count immediately.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1000 * N) bounded state breadth expansion
complexity.notes: Values outside [0, 1000] are only valid if they match the goal directly.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded expansion leads to infinite states and cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Restricting expansion to [0, 1000] keeps the state space strictly bounded.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that out-of-range states cannot be further expanded.
